scope: Global sources for Vaccinium phenology observations, cultivar traits, land use and protected cultivation, remote sensing, weather beyond report 07, and research literature access.

sources.name: USA-NPN National Phenology Database (Nature's Notebook) and data API
sources.blueberry_specificity: blueberry rows inside a broader dataset
sources.license_or_terms: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), per USA-NPN Data Use Policy
extractable_fields: phenophase (breaking leaf buds, flowers or flower buds, open flowers, full flowering 50%, fruits, ripe fruits)
first yes date and day of year
app_uses: validate cool-climate budbreak and bloom onset near Cherryfield (ME) and in New England
check NHB bloom month at Hammonton (NJ) against model flowering start
build a lowbush (wild) phenology prior for Lac-Saint-Jean style pins

verification.note: Observational data page opened. One API call to getSummarizedData.json for species_id 94, 1503, 1060 and 2289 (2009-01-01 to 2026-10-10) returned 7,885 individual-phenometric rows: highbush blueberry 4,898 rows (225 plants, 132 sites, 2009-2026), lowbush 2,716 (79 plants, 63 sites, 2015-2026), smallflower (V. virgatum) 36 (5 plants), Darrow's 235 (8 plants, all GA). Highbush open-flower onsets 421, ripe-fruit onsets 396. Fields seen: site_id, latitude, longitude, elevation_in_meters, state, species_id, individual_id, phenophase_id, phenophase_description, first_yes_year/month/day/doy, numdays_since_prior_no, last_yes_*, numdays_until_next_no. Within 100 km of the 17 US benchmark sites only Tallahassee (8 plants), Hammonton (6), Elizabethtown (2) and Burgaw (1) have records; none near Citra, Waldo, Alma, Homerville or Grand Junction. Near the Cherryfield pin: 19 plants, 17 open-flower onsets; near Lynden: 34 plants, 0 open-flower onsets.

sources.quality_caveats: Mostly wild or garden plants, not commercial fields; cultivar and management rarely recorded. Onset precision depends on visit gaps (2,867 of 4,898 highbush rows had a prior 'no' within 7 days). Almost no Florida or Georgia coverage (2 highbush plants in FL). Open-flower status is not a cumulative bloom curve.
sources.priority_reason: The only open, dated, stage-defined Vaccinium observation network with an API, already CC BY 4.0, and it covers the cool-climate pins the model cannot handle today.

flag cultivated plants with the captive filter

verification.note: API docs opened; website pages returned a Cloudflare 403. Counts via /v1/observations (all quality grades) using controlled term 12 'Flowers and Fruits' (13 Flowers, 14 Fruits or Seeds, 15 Flower Buds) and term 36 'Leaves' (37 Breaking Leaf Buds): V. corymbosum (taxon 52740) 25,852 observations, 1,063 Flowers, 1,261 Fruits, 293 Flower Buds, 52 Breaking Leaf Buds, 3,338 captive/cultivated; V. angustifolium (84542) 34,063 / 1,697 / 1,750 / 287 / 35, 474 captive; V. virgatum (52742) 873 / 31 / 34 / 8 / 2, 108 captive; V. darrowii (126142) 2,271 / 64 / 100 / 29 / 20. Only 2,619 corymbosum observations carry any term-12 annotation. Within 50 km (all four taxa): Hammonton 1,157 obs, 80 Flowers, 73 Fruits; Cherryfield pin 1,382 / 97 / 91; Citra 178 / 4 / 5; Grand Junction 185 / 1 / 10; Lynden pin 172 / 3 / 8; Alma 3; Chillan, Moguer, Lublin, Coffs Harbour 0 or 1. Sample record fields: observed_on, time_observed_at, location, positional_accuracy, quality_grade, captive, license_code, annotations (attribute and value ids with vote_score).

sources.quality_caveats: Opportunistic sampling: one photo shows presence of a stage, not onset. Annotation is optional and user-supplied. Wild V. corymbosum complex is not commercial cultivars. Request rate should stay near 1 call per second.
sources.priority_reason: Large, dated, geolocated flowering and fruiting evidence for wild and some cultivated Vaccinium in the US Northeast and Canada, but annotation coverage is about 10% and almost nothing exists near Southern Hemisphere production.

naturalised V. corymbosum presence in the Netherlands as a location check

verification.note: API used with limit=0 count queries; gbif.org web pages returned Cloudflare 403. Backbone matches: V. corymbosum key 2882849 (V. ashei is treated as a synonym of it), V. angustifolium 2882868, V. darrowii 2882908; 'Vaccinium virgatum' did not match a species in the backbone (fell back to genus). Counts: V. corymbosum 37,723 (24,725 preserved specimens, 10,569 human observations; US 30,694, NL 2,592, CA 1,327); V. angustifolium 22,030 (US 11,855, CA 9,535); V. darrowii 2,386; genus Vaccinium 2,713,837. iNaturalist research-grade dataset holds 6,450 V. corymbosum records in GBIF; its dataset licence is CC BY-NC 4.0. A sample iNaturalist record had reproductiveCondition and lifeStage empty.

sources.quality_caveats: Taxonomy: rabbiteye (V. virgatum/ashei) cannot be separated from V. corymbosum in the GBIF backbone. Some records geocoded to odd countries (262 corymbosum records in 'AF'). Specimen dates show flowering presence, not onset.
sources.priority_reason: Good for presence and herbarium flowering dates but phenology fields are mostly empty, so iNaturalist and NPN are better primary sources.

sources.name: UPOV Test Guidelines TG/137/5 Rev. Blueberry
sources.publisher: International Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants
app_uses: define relative bloom and ripening classes in the cultivar table
map PBR descriptions to a common scale

verification.note: PDF opened (TG/137/5 Rev., 2019-06-14 + 2022-10-25). Covers V. corymbosum, angustifolium, virgatum, darrowii and hybrids. Characteristics 34 to 37 are 'Time of beginning of flowering' and 'Time of beginning of fruit ripening' on one-year-old and current-season shoots, scored 1 to 9 with example varieties (for example flowering: Patriot 1, Weymouth 3, Berkeley 5, Darrow 7, Jersey 9; ripening: Bluetta 1, Blueray 3, Heerma 5, Darrow 7, Elizabeth 9). Example varieties are tagged (H) high chill >750 h or (L) low chill <600 h, with chill hours defined as hours below 7 C.

sources.quality_caveats: Notes are relative to example varieties grown at a test site, not dates.
sources.priority_reason: Provides the standard coded scales that PBR and CPVO descriptions use, so it fixes the cultivar-table schema for timing traits.
